subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Lifestyle Creep
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Lifestyle Creep.

hook.text: You earned $50,000 and saved $5,000. Now you earn $100,000 and save. $5,000.

buildup.text: Lifestyle creep: as income rises, spending rises to match. The savings rate stays flat or even drops.

discovery.text: Hedonic adaptation fuels the creep. Each upgrade becomes the new baseline. What was a luxury becomes a necessity.

twist.text: High earners often have less financial freedom than moderate earners who kept expenses low.

climax.text: Auto-save a percentage of every raise before it hits your spending account. You can't miss what you never see.

punchline.text: Earn more. Keep the same life. Save the gap.

quiz.question: What causes lifestyle creep?
options: Spending increases to match rising income
People become more frugal as they earn more
